stem: A cricket academy in Peshawar charges every junior member the same monthly fee and every senior member the same monthly fee. In one month, 12 junior members and 8 senior members paid a total of 76,000 rupees. In another month, 10 junior members and 15 senior members paid a total of 100,000 rupees. What is the monthly fee, in rupees, for a senior member?
solution: Let \(j\) and \(s\) be the junior and senior fees: \(12j + 8s = 76{,}000\) and \(10j + 15s = 100{,}000\).
Multiply the first equation by 5 and the second by 6: \(60j + 40s = 380{,}000\) and \(60j + 90s = 600{,}000\).
verify:
j, s = symbols('j s')
sol = solve([12*j + 8*s - 76000, 10*j + 15*s - 100000], [j, s])
assert sol == {j: 3400, s: 4400}
assert [Rational(v) for v in spr_answers] == [sol[s]]
